title: A First Glance at Jev for Network Traffic Classification: Accuracy, Processing Time, and Cost
abstract: arXiv:2610.00376v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We evaluate Jev on ten dataset-defined application labels in CESNET-QUICEXT-25 using only the first ten packets' sizes, directions, and inter-packet times. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first empirical study of general-purpose decision models, represented here by Jev, for application classification of network flows. Across 52,000 records from 26 collection weeks following the training period, 40 fixed labeled examples raise Jev's accuracy from 9.80% to 28.42%. Random Forest and Extra Trees trained on 8,000 records achieve 69.95% and 66.80% and outperform Jev in every week. Increasing Jev's context to 150 examples yields 34.50% on the first test week. On a paired 100-record subset, Jev with 40 examples achieves 29% accuracy at a median request time of 0.750 s, versus 37% and 6.036 s for the generative language model OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol with high reasoning effort through Azure; Jev also incurs lower API charges. translated_title: Jev在网络流量分类中的初步研究：准确率、处理时间与成本
translated_abstract: 我们在CESNET-QUICEXT-25数据集上评估了Jev在十个由数据集定义的应用标签上的表现，仅使用前十个数据包的大小、方向和数据包间时间。据我们所知，这是首次针对通用决策模型（此处以Jev为代表）在网络流应用分类中的实证研究。在训练期之后26个采集周的52,000条记录中，40个固定标注样本将Jev的准确率从9.80%提升至28.42%。基于8,000条记录训练的随机森林和极端随机树分别达到69.95%和66.80%的准确率，并在每一周都优于Jev。将Jev的上下文增加到150个样本后，其在第一个测试周的准确率达到34.50%。在配对的100条记录子集上，使用40个样本的Jev以0.750秒的中位请求时间达到29%的准确率，而通过Azure使用高推理强度的生成式语言模型OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol则分别为37%的准确率和6.036秒的请求时间；此外，Jev的API调用费用也更低。
tldr: 本文首次实证评估了通用决策模型Jev在QUIC网络流量应用分类中的表现，发现其准确率虽低于随机森林等传统机器学习方法，但相比GPT-5.6等大语言模型具有更快的处理速度和更低的成本。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first empirical study of the general-purpose decision model Jev for QUIC network traffic application classification, showing that although its accuracy falls short of traditional machine learning methods like Random Forest, Jev offers faster processing and lower costs compared to large language models such as GPT-5.6.
